amendment_history.note: الإصدار الأصلي (13 مادة، بلا تقسيم إلى أبواب أو فصول) -- تنظيم المؤسسة العامة للتدريب التقني والمهني، نُشر بتاريخ 25/8/1428هـ، حل محل نظام المؤسسة العامة للتعليم الفني والتدريب المهني الصادر بالمرسوم الملكي رقم (م/30) وتاريخ 10/8/1400هـ (م12).

عدّل الفقرة (1) من المادة الرابعة (تشكيل مجلس الإدارة) بنص مستبدل بالكامل ومقتبس حرفياً في نافذة "تعديلات المادة" -- ثم عُدّل هذا النص لاحقاً بقراري مجلس الوزراء رقمي (693) و(745) (انظر أدناه؛ التعديلات الثلاثة مسجلة هنا دون دمجها في نص موحّد، انظر known_unresolved_discrepancies).

عدّل المادة الرابعة مجدداً: إحلال عبارة (وزارة الطاقة) محل عبارة (وزارة الطاقة والصناعة والثروة المعدنية) الواردة في الفقرة (1/و)، مع إضافة ممثل من وزارة الصناعة والثروة المعدنية إلى عضوية مجلس الإدارة (دون تحديد موضعه الحرفي في القائمة).
عدّل المادة الرابعة مجدداً بإضافة ممثل من الهيئة السعودية للمدن الصناعية ومناطق التقنية إلى عضوية مجلس الإدارة (دون تحديد موضعه الحرفي في القائمة).

عدّل صدر المادة السابعة فقط (الجملة التمهيدية المتعلقة بتعيين المحافظ، دون اختصاصاته المُرقّمة الإحدى عشرة أو جملة التفويض الختامية)، ليصبح: "يكون للمؤسسة محافظ يعين ويعفى من منصبه بقرار من المجلس بعد موافقة رئيس مجلس الوزراء، ويحدد القرار أجره ومزاياه المالية الأخرى." نُشر في جريدة أم القرى العدد (5074) بتاريخ 7 مارس 2025م -- غير منعكس في أي من ثلاث لقطات أرشيفية مستقلة لصفحة هيئة الخبراء بمجلس الوزراء (انظر known_unresolved_discrepancies)؛ مصدر هذا التعديل في هذا المسار هو qanoonsa.com وتجميع WebSearch مستقل، لا هيئة الخبراء ذاتها.

chapter_structure.label_ar: بدون تقسيم إلى أبواب أو فصول
chapter_structure.title_ar: مواد متسلسلة غير مجمعة تحت أبواب أو فصول رسمية، لا يحمل أي منها عنواناً فرعياً في المصدر: التعريفات (م1) -- الشخصية الاعتبارية والاستقلال المالي والإداري ومقر المؤسسة (م2) -- أهداف المؤسسة واختصاصاتها العامة (م3) -- تشكيل مجلس الإدارة، معدّلة ثلاث مرات (م4) -- اختصاصات المجلس (م5) -- اجتماعات المجلس وقراراته (م6) -- المحافظ واختصاصاته، معدّل صدرها (م7) -- ميزانية المؤسسة المستقلة (م8) -- الموارد المالية للمؤسسة (م9) -- السنة المالية (م10) -- مراجع الحسابات الخارجي ورقابة ديوان المراقبة العامة (م11) -- إحلال هذا التنظيم محل التنظيم السابق (م12) -- النشر والنفاذ (م13).

verification_methodology_note:
PRIMARY SOURCE ACCESS: laws.boe.gov.sa's LIVE portal returned HTTP 503/connection failure this pass for this law's exact detail URL (https://laws.boe.gov.sa/BoeLaws/Laws/LawDetails/750bf502-86c2-4928-bdb9-a9a700f1ff3b/1), consistent with this corpus's established reachability pattern for this portal. THREE independent Wayback Machine snapshots of this exact URL were fetched via direct curl over the pre-configured proxy and parsed offline with BeautifulSoup: 20200116032859 (16 Jan 2020), 20221201180134 (1 Dec 2022), and 20250507014004 (7 May 2025). All 13 'article_item' divs are present in every snapshot, in the same order and sequence (المادة الأولى through المادة الثالثة عشرة). Only Article 4 ever carries BOE's own 'changed-article' CSS class with a nested 'تعديلات المادة' changelog popup; the other 12 -- INCLUDING Article 7, see below -- carry only 'no_alternate' and are BYTE-FOR-BYTE IDENTICAL across all three time-points (confirmed by SHA-256 hashing each article_item's extracted text independently at each snapshot). This law has NO أبواب or فصول -- a flat sequence of 13 individually numbered مواد, confirmed by the complete absence of any باب/فصل-prefixed heading anywhere in the archived HTML across all three snapshots. No article carries an inline topic title in the BOE source (every 'h3.center' heading is a bare ordinal followed only by a colon, e.g. 'المادة الأولى:') -- consistent with this corpus's saudi_engineers_law/accounting_auditing_law/nazaha_law/awqaf_law precedent for BOE sources lacking inline per-article titles; no title_ar key is used.

DECREE IDENTIFICATION: Council of Ministers Resolution No. (268) dated 14/8/1428هـ, 13 articles, no أبواب/فصول subdivision. This is independently confirmed via FOUR sources: (1) BOE's own 'أدوات إصدار النظام' metadata field ('قرار مجلس الوزراء رقم 268 بتاريخ 14 / 8 / 1428'); (2) TVTC's own official website (tvtc.gov.sa/ar/About/Pages/TVTCRegulation.aspx, fetched this pass via a Wayback snapshot dated 21 Jun 2025 -- after Resolution 632's own date -- reading '​صدر قرار مجلس الوزراء رقم 268 بتاريخ 14 / 8 / 1428 بتنظيم المؤسسة العامة للتدريب التقني والمهني...' and providing only a summary plus a link back to BOE's own portal, not the full article text; its own page footer shows 'آخر تحديث 27/11/2024', i.e. LAST UPDATED BEFORE Resolution 632's own 26/8/1446H [Feb 2025] date, consistent with -- though not independent proof of -- BOE's own similar staleness for that specific amendment); (3) an independent legal aggregator, nezams.com, fetched live this pass, whose own structured summary independently confirms the decree number/date, exactly 13 articles, no أبواب/فصول, and the SAME three Article-4 amendments (469, 693, 745) with matching decree numbers/dates -- but notably makes NO mention of Resolution 632 anywhere, and its own quoted Article 7 text matches BOE's stale pre-632 wording exactly, an independent corroboration of BOE's own staleness rather than a contradiction; and (4) a WebSearch aggregation independently corroborating the same decree/resolution numbers and dates.

BOE METADATA ANOMALIES (informational, not substantive, following this corpus's saudi_engineers_law precedent for exactly this class of issue): BOE's own metadata panel lists 'تاريخ الإصدار' (issuance date) as '1428/08/15 هـ الموافق 28/08/2007 مـ' -- ONE DAY off from the decree's own well-attested date of 14/8/1428هـ, which is independently confirmed by the SAME BOE page's own separate 'أدوات إصدار النظام' field, by TVTC's own official website, by Council of Ministers Resolution 632's own preamble (which cites 'الصادر بقرار مجلس الوزراء رقم (268) وتاريخ 14/8/1428هـ' verbatim), and by nezams.com. Separately, BOE's own 'تاريخ النشر' (publication date) field reads '1428/01/01 هـ الموافق 20/01/2007 مـ' -- '1 Muharram' again has the hallmark of a database placeholder/default value (the exact same anomaly pattern documented in this corpus's saudi_engineers_law track), inconsistent with the well-attested publication date of 25/8/1428هـ per TVTC's own official website and nezams.com. Both are flagged as BOE metadata-field quality issues specific to this law's page, not substantive disputes about the real decree/publication dates.

ARTICLE 4 (BOARD COMPOSITION) -- THREE LAYERED PARTIAL AMENDMENTS, NOT SAFELY MERGEABLE: Article 4 is the only one of 13 articles flagged 'changed-article' on BOE's page, with a 'تعديلات المادة' popup containing THREE separate, chronologically ordered amendment entries, each read directly from BOE's raw HTML this pass: (1) Council of Ministers Resolution 469 (20/7/1438هـ) -- a clean, COMPLETE quoted replacement of paragraph (1) in full (new board membership: Minister of Education as chair, seven lettered seats أ-ز, plus 'ح' five private-sector experts); (2) Council of Ministers Resolution 693 (2/11/1441هـ) -- TWO partial instructions operating on top of Resolution 469's own text: a clean phrase substitution ('وزارة الطاقة' for 'وزارة الطاقة والصناعة والثروة المعدنية' in sub-paragraph 1/و) PLUS a bare instruction to ADD a seat for a representative of 'وزارة الصناعة والثروة المعدنية' without specifying its lettered position in the list; (3) Council of Ministers Resolution 745 (24/12/1442هـ) -- another bare instruction to ADD a seat for a representative of 'الهيئة السعودية للمدن الصناعية ومناطق التقنية' (MODON), again without specifying its lettered position. Confirmed via THREE independent BOE snapshots that this changelog accumulates incrementally exactly as expected (16 Jan 2020: only entry 469 present, since 693 postdates this snapshot; 1 Dec 2022 and 7 May 2025: all three entries present, unchanged between these two snapshots). Unlike this corpus's saudi_engineers_law Article 6 precedent (two amendments, EACH a complete, self-contained quoted replacement, safely superseded by ingesting only the most recent complete quote), entries (2) and (3) here are NOT complete replacement texts -- they are bare 'add a seat' instructions with no stated insertion point in the lettered sequence, and entry (2) additionally modifies text that only exists because of entry (1)'s own substitution. Reconstructing a single 'current' board-composition paragraph would require this track to invent letter assignments (e.g., is the new MODON seat 'ط' or does it renumber existing letters?) not stated by any source -- an interpretive act this track's trust constraint forbids. Following this corpus's awqaf_law precedent for exactly this internally-layered-but-not-safely-mergeable amendment pattern, this track ingests BOE's own STALE MAIN-BODY text (the original 1428H/2007G wording, predating even Resolution 469) as Article 4's ingested 'text', marks it معدلة, and records all three amendment entries verbatim and in full in amendment_history WITHOUT attempting to merge them into a single reconstructed current text (see known_unresolved_discrepancies, key tvtc_article4_three_layered_amendments_not_safely_mergeable).

ARTICLE 7 (GOVERNOR) -- RESOLUTION 632 AMENDMENT NOT YET IN BOE'S OWN DATABASE: per this track's task brief, Council of Ministers Resolution No. 632 was specifically researched. No laws.boe.gov.sa changelog entry or main-body change for Article 7 was found in ANY of the three independently-fetched BOE snapshots spanning Jan 2020 - May 2025 -- Article 7 carries NO 'changed-article' class in any of them, and its main-body text is BYTE-IDENTICAL across all three. This pass instead located Resolution 632's own text via qanoonsa.com (an independent Saudi legal-aggregator site, fetched live this pass via direct curl, HTTP 200), which reproduces what presents as the resolution's full official Umm Al-Qura-style text verbatim, including its complete procedural preamble (Royal Diwan correspondence No. 60230 dated 19/8/1446هـ enclosing Royal Diwan telegram No. 57222 dated 8/8/1446هـ; Bureau of Experts memoranda No. 2786 and 2898; Economic and Development Affairs Council minutes No. 1198/46/م; General Committee of the Council of Ministers recommendation No. 8624), its single operative clause ('يقرر: تعديل صدر المادة (السابعة) من تنظيم المؤسسة العامة للتدريب التقني والمهني، الصادر بقرار مجلس الوزراء رقم (268) وتاريخ 14/8/1428هـ، ليكون بالنص الآتي: يكون للمؤسسة محافظ يعين ويعفى من منصبه بقرار من المجلس بعد موافقة رئيس مجلس الوزراء، ويحدد القرار أجره ومزاياه المالية الأخرى.'), the King's signature block, and the Umm Al-Qura issue citation (العدد 5074، 7 مارس 2025م). An independent WebSearch aggregation, queried separately this pass, quoted the identical operative-clause wording verbatim, giving cross-source corroboration. The resolution amends ONLY the 'صدر' (introductory/opening clause) of Article 7 -- the single sentence preceding 'وله بوجه خاص ما يلي:' -- NOT the eleven enumerated governor's-duties items or the article's closing delegation sentence, both of which are left untouched and are carried over verbatim from BOE's own stable text. This track ingests the amended صدر text spliced with the unchanged remainder as Article 7's current text, marks it معدلة, and flags this honestly as resting on non-BOE, non-uqn.gov.sa corroboration only (see known_unresolved_discrepancies, key tvtc_article7_resolution632_not_in_boe_changelog).

UMM AL-QURA GAZETTE ATTEMPT: a direct search of uqn.gov.sa (the official gazette site) for issue 5074 or Resolution 632 by number/date returned no usable result this pass -- consistent with this corpus's established saudi_engineers_law/sdaia_organizational_arrangements finding that uqn.gov.sa is not practically searchable this way via WebFetch/WebSearch. Not pursued further per this corpus's 1-2-verification-attempts-per-fact policy, given the amendment is already independently corroborated by two non-BOE sources with matching verbatim text (see known_unresolved_discrepancies, key tvtc_uqn_gazette_unreachable).

PREDECESSOR -- CONFIRMED, NAMED (a positive finding, unlike several sibling tracks in this corpus): Article 12 explicitly repeals and replaces نظام المؤسسة العامة للتعليم الفني والتدريب المهني (the Statute of the General Organization for Technical Education and Vocational Training), Royal Decree م/30 dated 10/8/1400هـ, by name -- 'يحل هذا التنظيم محل نظام المؤسسة العامة للتعليم الفني والتدريب المهني، الصادر بالمرسوم الملكي رقم (م/30) وتاريخ 10/8/1400هـ، ويلغي كل ما يتعارض معه من أحكام.' This predecessor instrument itself is NOT ingested in this pass (one-instrument-per-pass precedent).

STRUCTURE: this Law has NO أبواب/فصول subdivision -- a flat sequence of 13 articles, confirmed by the absence of any باب/فصل-prefixed heading across all three independently-fetched BOE snapshots and independently corroborated by nezams.com's own structurally-parallel 13-article summary.

IMPLEMENTING REGULATIONS NOT INGESTED: this law's own Article 5 references multiple اللوائح (internal/executive regulations) to be approved by the Board -- financial/administrative regulations (item 3), training-unit regulations (item 4), private-sector training regulations (item 5), and trainee stipend regulations (item 6). None of these regulations is ingested, fabricated, or partially guessed at in this pass -- flagged as a candidate for dedicated follow-up ingestion (see known_unresolved_discrepancies, key tvtc_implementing_regs_not_ingested).

No legal text is altered beyond whitespace normalization needed to render BOE's HTML (table-row/cell boundaries) as plain text (collapsing one incidental missing space in Article 4's original sub-paragraph 1/و, where BOE's own source HTML merges 'والصناعة' and 'عضواً' into a single table cell with no space between them -- a rendering artifact, not a substantive edit) and, for Article 7 only, splicing Resolution 632's own quoted صدر substitution onto the article's otherwise-unchanged, independently-verified-stable remainder (see above). Arabic governs; no translation/paraphrase/interpretation performed on the Arabic text (English descriptions in this note and in document_en/issuing_authority_en are for indexing only). Read-only over input; deterministic over outputs.

known_unresolved_discrepancies.description: Article 4 (board composition) carries THREE chronologically layered amendments per BOE's own 'تعديلات المادة' changelog -- Council of Ministers Resolution 469 (20/7/1438هـ, a complete quoted paragraph replacement), Resolution 693 (2/11/1441هـ, a phrase substitution PLUS a bare 'add a seat' instruction with no stated lettered position), and Resolution 745 (24/12/1442هـ, another bare 'add a seat' instruction with no stated lettered position). Unlike this corpus's saudi_engineers_law Article 6 precedent (two amendments, each independently a complete, self-contained quoted replacement, safely resolved by ingesting only the most recent complete quote), entries 2 and 3 here are NOT complete replacement texts and cannot be safely merged into one reconstructed 'current' board-composition paragraph without this track inventing letter assignments not stated by any source -- an interpretive act forbidden by this track's trust constraint. Following this corpus's awqaf_law precedent for internally-layered-but-not-safely-mergeable amendments, this track ingests BOE's own STALE main-body text (the original 1428H/2007G wording, predating even Resolution 469) as Article 4's 'text' field, marks it معدلة, and records all three amendments verbatim in amendment_history WITHOUT merging them. Anyone relying on this track's Article 4 text as reflecting the CURRENT, actually-in-force board composition should treat that as unconfirmed by this track's own ingested text -- only the three individual amendment instructions themselves are confirmed, not their composite effect.

Council of Ministers Resolution No. 632 (26/8/1446هـ, 25 Feb 2025G, published Umm Al-Qura issue 5074, 7 Mar 2025G) amended ONLY the صدر (opening/introductory clause) of Article 7, per its own single operative clause: 'تعديل صدر المادة (السابعة) ... ليكون بالنص الآتي: يكون للمؤسسة محافظ يعين ويعفى من منصبه بقرار من المجلس بعد موافقة رئيس مجلس الوزراء، ويحدد القرار أجره ومزاياه المالية الأخرى.' This amendment is NOT reflected in ANY of three independently-fetched BOE archival snapshots (16 Jan 2020, 1 Dec 2022, 7 May 2025 -- the latter about two months AFTER the resolution's own Umm Al-Qura publication date) -- neither in Article 7's main body (byte-identical across all three snapshots) nor as a 'changed-article' flag or 'تعديلات المادة' changelog entry of any kind. This track's confirmation of Resolution 632 rests SOLELY on two independent non-BOE sources: qanoonsa.com (a Saudi legal aggregator, fetched live this pass via direct curl, reproducing what presents as the resolution's complete official Umm Al-Qura-style text -- full procedural preamble, single operative clause, King's signature block, and gazette issue citation) and a separately-queried WebSearch aggregation quoting identical wording. Direct confirmation from Umm Al-Qura's own gazette portal (uqn.gov.sa) could not be obtained this pass (see tvtc_uqn_gazette_unreachable below). This track ingests the amended صدر spliced with the unchanged, independently-verified-stable remainder of Article 7 (its 11 enumerated duties and closing delegation sentence) as the current text, but this rests on a materially thinner verification tier than this corpus's TIER_1 BOE-changelog-confirmed amendments -- a future pass with working access to uqn.gov.sa or a live/更新 BOE page should independently re-confirm this text.

BOE's own metadata panel for this law's page lists 'تاريخ الإصدار' (issuance date) as '1428/08/15 هـ الموافق 28/08/2007 مـ' -- ONE DAY off from this law's own well-attested decree date of 14/8/1428هـ, which is independently confirmed by the SAME BOE page's own separate 'أدوات إصدار النظام' field, by TVTC's own official website, by Council of Ministers Resolution 632's own preamble, and by nezams.com. Flagged as a BOE metadata-field quality issue specific to this law's page, not a substantive dispute about the actual decree date, which this track treats as well-settled (14/8/1428هـ).

BOE's own metadata panel additionally lists 'تاريخ النشر' (publication date) as '1428/01/01 هـ الموافق 20/01/2007 مـ' -- '1 Muharram', the first possible day of the hijri year, has the hallmark of a database placeholder/default value, exactly the same anomaly pattern documented in this corpus's saudi_engineers_law track for its 'تاريخ الإصدار' field. This is inconsistent with the well-attested publication date of 25/8/1428هـ per TVTC's own official website and nezams.com. Flagged as a BOE metadata-field quality issue, not a substantive dispute.

Unlike several sibling tracks in this corpus (e.g. saudi_engineers_law) where no predecessor instrument could be found, THIS law's own Article 12 explicitly names and repeals its predecessor: نظام المؤسسة العامة للتعليم الفني والتدريب المهني (the Statute of the General Organization for Technical Education and Vocational Training), Royal Decree م/30 dated 10/8/1400هـ -- a confirmed POSITIVE finding, not a gap. This predecessor instrument itself is not ingested in this pass (one-instrument-per-pass precedent) but is flagged here as a candidate for a dedicated follow-up track given its historical relationship to TVTC's own creation.

This law has NO أبواب (parts) or فصول (chapters) -- a flat sequence of 13 individually-numbered articles with no grouping/part headers anywhere on the BOE page across any of the three independently-fetched snapshots (no باب/فصل-prefixed heading was found alongside the 13 'article_item' divs in any snapshot). This track's chapter_structure field reflects this verified flat structure (a single leaf range 1-13) rather than inventing a topical grouping not present in the primary source.

This law's BOE-hosted HTML supplies NO inline title text for any of its 13 articles -- every 'h3.center' heading for an article is a bare ordinal followed only by a colon (e.g. 'المادة الأولى:'), across all three snapshots checked. Consistent with this corpus's saudi_engineers_law/accounting_auditing_law/nazaha_law/awqaf_law precedent for sources lacking inline per-article titles, no title_ar key is used for any article; section_ar instead carries a constant flat-structure note.

This law's own Article 5 references multiple اللوائح (internal/executive regulations) to be approved by the Board of Directors -- financial/administrative regulations (item 3), training-unit regulations (item 4), private-sector training regulations (item 5), and trainee stipend/incentive regulations (item 6). Per this corpus's established one-instrument-per-pass precedent, none of these regulations is ingested, fabricated, or partially guessed at in this pass -- flagged as a candidate for dedicated follow-up ingestion passes.

A direct search of uqn.gov.sa (the official Umm Al-Qura Gazette site) for issue 5074 or Council of Ministers Resolution 632 by number/date, attempted this pass via WebSearch and WebFetch, returned no usable primary-source result -- consistent with this corpus's established saudi_engineers_law/sdaia_organizational_arrangements finding that uqn.gov.sa is not practically searchable or scrapable this way. Not pursued further per this corpus's 1-2-verification-attempts-per-fact policy, given Resolution 632's substance is already independently corroborated by two non-BOE sources with matching verbatim text (see tvtc_article7_resolution632_not_in_boe_changelog above).

TVTC's own official website (tvtc.gov.sa/ar/About/Pages/TVTCRegulation.aspx, fetched this pass via a Wayback Machine snapshot dated 21 Jun 2025) does NOT host the full article-by-article text of its own organizing statute -- only a short prose summary and a link back to laws.boe.gov.sa's own portal for this exact law. Its page footer reads 'آخر تحديث 27/11/2024' (last updated 27 Nov 2024), i.e. BEFORE Resolution 632's own 26/8/1446H [Feb 2025] date -- consistent with, though not independent proof of, the same staleness documented for BOE's own page. This source was used only to corroborate the decree number/date (268, 14/8/1428هـ) and general description, not for any article's full text.
